title: Hospital laboratories
seo_description: Laboratory management software for hospital labs: sample tracking, turnaround targets for urgent cases, signed report release, role-based access, and audit trails.

fields.hero_lead: Track every sample, keep urgent cases on target, and release reports only after an authorized doctor signs, with every action attributed and recorded.
fields.screen_alt: Labora screen used by hospital laboratories

pains.problem: Urgent samples wait in the same queue
pains.solution: Urgent cases are flagged and carry their own, shorter targets.

pains.problem: Hard to answer who changed a result
pains.solution: Every edit keeps the earlier value, the new value, the user, and the time.
Each role sees what it needs, by role and by center.

fields.cta_title: See Labora set up for hospital laboratories
fields.cta_text: Tell us how your lab works today. We will show you the same workflow in Labora, with your tests and price list.
